title: PREFLIGHT (adapter → runner)
description: PROPOSED (ADR-040, not yet accepted). A deliver adapter's answer, in a preflight session (OPEN with preflight: true, no records), to whether the live target is fit to send to: ok; blocked (a readable fact says sends would be meaningless or wrong — the runner fails the step before any record is dispatched); inconclusive (the target could not be read — reported ok with a warning). checks is what was examined, for the receipt.

reason.description: Why blocked or inconclusive. Omitted when empty.
